AMAN SIWACH

Phone: 9499311980

Email: amansiwach102002@gmail.com

Address: Village Padana, Post Office Nidani, District Jind, Haryana – 126102, India

Career Objective

Dedicated and hardworking Production Operator with hands-on experience in food manufacturing.
Seeking a Production Executive / Operator role in a reputed company where I can utilize my
technical skills, improve production efficiency, and grow professionally.

Work Experience

Production Operator – Lotte India Corporation Ltd., Rohtak, Haryana (May 2023 – Present)

• Operate and monitor syrup preparation machines
• Handle MBD Enrober operations for chocolate production
• Ensure adherence to GMP and food safety standards
• Maintain daily production reports and quality records
• Perform machine cleaning and preventive maintenance
• Handle production targets and minimize downtime
• Support team coordination and shift operations

Education

• 10th Pass
• 12th Pass
• ITI – Wireman Trade

Technical Skills

• Syrup Making & Mixing Process
• MBD Enrober Operation
• Production Line Monitoring
• Machine Maintenance & Cleaning
• Basic Electrical Knowledge
• Quality Control & Safety Compliance
• Team Coordination & Shift Handling

Certifications

Food Safety Supervisor – Certificate of Competence

• Course: Advance Manufacturing
• Issued by: FSSAI (Intertek India Pvt Ltd)
• Valid Till: 22 September 2027



Languages

• Hindi (Fluent)
• English (Basic)

Additional Information

• Ready to join immediately
